# GridStorm

> GridStorm is an open-source, headless enterprise data grid platform for the web.
> MIT-licensed core with 28+ composable plugins, virtual scrolling (100K+ rows @ 60fps),
> WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, 42-function Excel formula engine, Excel-compatible copy/paste,
> and framework adapters for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and Vanilla JS.

GridStorm ships as a pnpm monorepo with a sub-50 KB headless core, a DOM renderer,
framework adapters, and 28 plugins across three tiers:

- **Tier 1 (MIT, free forever)**: Sorting, Filtering, Selection, Editing, Pagination,
  Column Pinning, Column Resize, Column Reorder, Context Menu, Clipboard
- **Tier 2 (Pro)**: Grouping, Aggregation, Pivoting, Master-Detail, Tree Data,
  Row Reorder, Excel Export, PDF Export, Sparklines, Charts, Server-Side Row Model
- **Tier 3 / Next-Gen (Pro)**: Status Bar, State Persistence, Row Pinning,
  Conditional Formatting, Live Streaming, NL Query (AI/offline), Anomaly Detection (AI)

Install:
```
npm install @gridstorm/core @gridstorm/dom-renderer @gridstorm/react
```

- [Introduction](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/getting-started/introduction): What is GridStorm, architecture overview, and design goals
- [Quick Start](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/getting-started/quick-start): 5-minute guide to get a grid running in React
- [Installation](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/getting-started/installation): npm/pnpm install, peer deps, bundler setup

### Core Concepts

- [Architecture](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/architecture): Headless engine, store, command bus, event bus, and plugin lifecycle
- [Columns](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/columns): ColumnDef, field mapping, headerName, width, valueFormatter, cellRenderer
- [Row Data](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/row-data): RowNode model, data flow, rowId, and mutation patterns
- [Theming](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/theming): CSS custom properties, light/dark/high-contrast themes, density modes
- [Events & Commands](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/events-commands): Unidirectional event bus, command dispatch, plugin communication
- [Store](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/store): Immutable state slices, selectors, batched updates
- [DOM Renderer](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/dom-renderer): Virtual scroll, row/cell rendering, scroll sync, keyboard navigation
- [Plugin System (Deep Dive)](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/core-concepts/plugin-system): Topological resolution, lifecycle hooks, writing your own plugin

### Plugins — Core (Free, MIT)

- [Plugin System](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/plugin-system): Plugin API, install/uninstall, dependency ordering
- [Sorting](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/sorting): Single/multi-column sort, custom comparators, sort indicators
- [Filtering](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/filtering): Column filters, quick filter, floating filters, filter models
- [Selection](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/selection): Single/multi-row, checkbox column, range selection, selectAll
- [Editing](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/editing): Cell editors, start/stop editing, validation hooks, full-row mode
- [Pagination](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/pagination): Page size, go-to-page, total count, server-side compatible
- [Column Pinning](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/column-pinning): Pin columns left/right, frozen pane rendering
- [Column Resize](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/column-resize): Drag-to-resize, min/max width, auto-fit
- [Column Reorder](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/column-reorder): Drag-and-drop column rearrangement, lock positions
- [Context Menu](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/context-menu): Right-click menus, custom items, separator, async items
- [Clipboard](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/clipboard): Copy/paste cells and ranges, CSV format, custom serializers

### Plugins — Enterprise (Pro)

- [Grouping](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/grouping): Row grouping by column, group expand/collapse, group footers
- [Aggregation](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/aggregation): sum, avg, min, max, count per group, custom aggregators
- [Pivoting](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/pivoting): Pivot columns, cross-tab layout, pivot value aggregation
- [Master Detail](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/master-detail): Expandable row detail panels, nested grids
- [Tree Data](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/tree-data): Hierarchical row data, tree expand/collapse, path-based data
- [Row Reorder](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/row-reorder): Drag rows to reorder, event callbacks
- [Excel Export](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/excel-export): Export to .xlsx with styles, formulas, column widths
- [PDF Export](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/pdf-export): Export grid to PDF with pagination and theming
- [Sparklines](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/sparklines): Inline mini-charts (line, bar, area) in cells
- [Charts](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/charts): Full chart panel from selected ranges — bar, line, scatter, pie
- [Server-Side Row Model](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/ssrm): Lazy-load rows from server, infinite scroll, server-side grouping

### Plugins — Next-Gen (Pro)

- [Status Bar](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/status-bar): Aggregation summary bar (sum/avg/min/max/count), selection-aware
- [State Persistence](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/state-persistence): Auto-save/restore grid state to localStorage or custom storage; commands: state:save, state:restore, state:clear
- [Row Pinning](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/row-pinning): Pin rows to top/bottom (floating rows), capacity limits
- [Conditional Formatting](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/conditional-formatting): 18 condition types — colorScale, dataBar, iconSet, topN, aboveAverage, etc.
- [Streaming / Live Data](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/streaming): Real-time updates via command streaming:push-updates, cell direction tracking, batched processing
- [AI Integration](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/ai): NL Query (nlquery:execute command, offline regex engine) and Anomaly Detection (Z-score + IQR, columnId/watchThreshold/warningThreshold/criticalThreshold/windowSize config)

### Plugins — Differentiators

- [Formula Engine](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/formula): Cell formula parsing, 42 Excel-compatible functions, dependency tracking
- [Time Travel](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/time-travel): Undo/redo for all grid state changes
- [Cell Range Selection](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/cell-range): Excel-like range selection, fill handle, range copy
- [Data Validation](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/validation): Cell-level validation rules, error display, blocking vs warning mode

### Plugins — Enterprise Tier

- [Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/a11y): Full keyboard navigation, ARIA roles, screen-reader announcements
- [Formula Engine Pro](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/formula-engine): 42 Excel functions, cross-cell dependencies, array formulas
- [Clipboard Pro](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/plugins/clipboard-pro): Excel-compatible copy/paste, rich formatting preservation

### Framework Guides

- [React](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/frameworks/react): `<GridStorm>` component, hooks (useGridState, useGridSort, useGridFilter, useGridSelection), portals, error boundary
- [Vue](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/frameworks/vue): `<GridStorm>` Vue 3 component, composables
- [Svelte](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/frameworks/svelte): `<GridStorm>` Svelte 4 component, stores
- [Angular](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/frameworks/angular): `GridStormModule`, input bindings, event outputs
- [Vanilla JS](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/frameworks/vanilla): createGrid(), DOM renderer, no framework required

- [MCP Server (AI Integration)](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/guides/mcp-server): Expose grid state to LLMs via Model Context Protocol
- [PDF Toolkit](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/guides/pdf-toolkit): WASM-based PDF rendering, text extraction, full-text search, AI redaction
- [Integration Guide](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/guides/integration-guide): Adding GridStorm to existing React/Vue/Angular projects
- [Custom Plugins](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/guides/custom-plugins): Writing, registering, and publishing your own GridStorm plugin
- [Performance](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/guides/performance): Virtual scroll tuning, row height modes, batch update patterns
- [Accessibility](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/guides/accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA compliance checklist, keyboard navigation, ARIA

### API Reference

- [GridConfig](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/api/grid-config): All top-level props: columns, rowData, plugins, rowHeight, headerHeight, theme, etc.
- [GridApi](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/api/grid-api): dispatchCommand, addEventListener, setSortModel, setFilterModel, getAllColumns, applyColumnState
- [Column Definitions](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/api/column-definitions): ColumnDef type, all fields, cellRenderer, valueFormatter, sortable, filterable, editable
- [Row Nodes](https://gridstorm.tekivex.com/#/docs/api/row-nodes): RowNode, rowId, data, children, expanded, pinned

### Key Technical Notes for LLMs

- Plugin options use exact TypeScript types — e.g. StatePersistenceOptions has: storageKey, storage, autoSave, debounceMs, include, exclude, migrations, onRestoreError
- State persistence commands: 'state:save', 'state:restore', 'state:clear', 'state:export', 'state:import'
- NL Query command: 'nlquery:execute' (not 'nl-query:process'). NlQueryOptions: maxHistory, caseSensitive, columnAliases only
- AnomalyPlugin column config: { columnId, watchThreshold, warningThreshold, criticalThreshold, windowSize }
- StatusBarPlugin event: 'status-bar:updated' with aggregations object per configured column
- StreamingPlugin command: 'streaming:push-updates', event: 'streaming:stats'
- RowPinningPlugin commands: 'row-pinning:pin', 'row-pinning:clear-all'; event: 'row-pinning:changed'
- ConditionalFormattingPlugin: 18 condition types including colorScale, dataBar, iconSet, topN, aboveAverage
- CSS custom properties namespace: --hub-* (hub UI), --gs-* (grid theming)
- GridEventMap does not have extensible index signature — plugins must use 'as any' for custom events
- Framework adapters: @gridstorm/react, @gridstorm/vue, @gridstorm/angular, @gridstorm/svelte
- GitHub: https://github.com/007krcs/grid-data
